caption: Solhint: security rules + style-guide rules, per project.

code:
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: forge fmt --check
      - run: npx solhint 'src/**/*.sol'

  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
caption: needs: lint — the expensive job waits on the cheap one passing first.
